method: All immutable M26 source features deduplicated by source ID; visible line lengths and polygon PERIMETERS separated. Admitted length counts each source edge once per mode regardless of direction, in EPSG:2154. Raw whole-way corpus can extend beyond the prepared tiles. Coverage-clipped lengths merge all segment intervals in the union of 499 squares, whose margins also extend beyond the administrative boundary. These are source-line inventories, not a count of rendered frames or physically validated roads. Routing is topology only, not a physical traversal or measured field access.
